description: What a group (team or portal) may do on a table or report, and whether its people see ONLY THEIR OWN records there. For a group that already has rights on the table pass ONLY what the person asked to change: «technicians see only their own orders» is only_own_records: true with NO role — a role you pass replaces the group's present one. The answer says CHANGED / UNCHANGED for the role and for only_own_records, and what «own» means: repeat that meaning, never «assigned to them». Sets the rights of a group (team or portal) on a form or report. role: 1=administrator: everything, as the owner; 2=read only; 3=read, write and DELETE records; 4=read, write and DELETE records, and build forms; 5=read and write records, NO delete; 6=read, edit and DELETE records; 7=read and edit records, NO delete. When the person asked that these people cannot delete, pass only a role that says NO delete (or read only), never one that says DELETE; and tell the person what the role lets them do in these words. «Make them an admin / let them see everything, as I do» is role 1 («Admin» on the screen). Pass either user_group_id (team) or portal_group_id (portal).

add_related_records.description: The «add a linked record» button in the card (works together with show_related_records).

hidden_columns.description: Fields (names or IDs) this group does NOT see in the TABLE (the list of records). Independent of hidden_fields: a field can stay in the form but be removed from the table. The same list-replacing semantics.

hidden_fields.description: Fields (names or IDs) this group does NOT see in the record FORM. This is how a form is narrowed: e.g. a rank-and-file employee fills in seven fields of a lead instead of all thirty-three. Pass the full list of hidden fields — it replaces the current one; an empty array [] shows everything. Not passed at all — the existing setting is not touched.

only_own_records.description: true: people of this group see only the records they added or were made owner of. false: they see everyone's. For a group of people from OUTSIDE the owner's business — clients, tenants, students, patients, suppliers — pass true unless the person said these people see everyone's records: one client must not read another's. For the owner's own staff leave it out unless the person asked. Tell the person which of the two you set.

revoke.description: true — TAKE AWAY this group's right on this form/report (the rule is removed). Roles 1..7 have no «no access» value, so this is the only way to revoke. role is not needed with revoke. If there was no rule, the answer is not_found and nothing changes.

role.description: 1=administrator: everything, as the owner; 2=read only; 3=read, write and DELETE records; 4=read, write and DELETE records, and build forms; 5=read and write records, NO delete; 6=read, edit and DELETE records; 7=read and edit records, NO delete. When the person asked that these people cannot delete, pass only a role that says NO delete (or read only), never one that says DELETE; and tell the person what the role lets them do in these words. Needed only for a group with no rights on this table yet; otherwise leave it out unless the person asked to change what the group may do.

show_related_records.description: Show in the record's card the block of linked records from other tables (e.g. an employee's salary rows in the employee's card). Without it the group sees only the card itself, even with a right on the linked table.

view_record_history.description: Let this group see the record's «History» tab (who changed what, when, what it was → what it became). Off by default: the history shows fields' old values.

name: set_table_permission
